events.title: February book night
events.description: Our first real meeting. Bring the book and a mug if you have a favorite, since the host has plenty of tea but not many cups. One guest each, and buzz 4C when you get there.

events.title: Winter potluck
events.description: Bring a dish to share with its own serving spoon, and label anything with nuts. Kids are welcome and there will be a coloring table in the corner. Up to three guests per household.

events.title: Spring season kickoff
events.description: Meet the coaches, pick up practice shirts and get the spring schedule. Kids should wear cleats, they will scrimmage for the last half hour. Parking fills up fast, so use the lot behind the tennis courts.

events.title: April book night
events.description: We finish talking through the March pick and choose what comes next, so come with one suggestion. It is a small room, so RSVP only if you are sure, and one guest at most.

events.title: Team photo day
events.description: Full uniform please, socks up and shin guards on. Individual photos go first and the team photo is at 9:45. Order forms come home with the kids, nothing to pay on the day.

events.title: Spring garden build day
events.description: We are building four raised beds and filling them with soil. Gloves and tools come from the tool library, but bring a water bottle and closed shoes. If it rains we move to the next Saturday.

events.title: End-of-season team picnic
events.description: Last day of the season, with medals handed out around noon. The team covers sandwiches and fruit; families bring a side or dessert. Two guests per family, and babies under two do not need a place.

events.title: June book night
events.description: Outside at the courtyard tables for the first time this year, so bring a cushion and bug spray. If it rains we move to the community room. Members plus one guest.

events.title: Courtyard movie night
events.description: A family film projected on the courtyard wall once it gets dark, around 8:45. Bring blankets or a folding chair; popcorn is on the co-op. Quiet hours start at 10:30 and we will wrap up before then.

events.title: Summer reading swap
events.description: Bring up to five books you are done with and leave with as many as you like. Anything left over stays on the community room shelf for the building. No reading required, one guest each.

events.title: Bike room cleanout
events.description: Clearing out abandoned bikes and old parts before the new keys go into use. Residents only, no guests. Bring your old key to swap at the office, and tag your bike if you want it to stay.

events.title: Fall season kickoff
events.description: New season, new roster. Hand medical forms to the assistant coach, try on jerseys from the swap box, and stay for a short chat about the snack rota. It will be hot, so send a full water bottle and sunscreen.

events.title: October book night
events.description: Back indoors at the host's flat for the cooler months. Please arrive by 7 so we can start on time, and message the host ahead if you are bringing your one guest.

events.title: Pumpkin patch outing
events.description: Hay ride, a small corn maze and one pumpkin per player, paid from the team fund. Wear boots, the paths get muddy. Carpools leave the park lot at 9:30, so tell the assistant coach if you have spare seats.

events.title: Fall work day
events.description: Pulling the summer beds, planting garlic and raking leaves into the compost bays. The tool library brings rakes and the post-hole digger for the new fence posts. Coffee from 9, one guest per household.

events.title: Fall awards night
events.description: Every player gets a certificate and the team award winners get trophies. Helpers, please claim a slot on the sheet for hall setup or snacks. Two guests per family, so grandparents can come.

events.title: December book night
events.description: The group has grown, so we are in the community room this time. The host is bringing cake and there will be hot cider. Bringing a short poem to read aloud is optional; one guest per member.

events.title: Holiday lights party
events.description: Help string lights in the courtyard trees at 5, then come inside for food and cocoa. Claim a main, side or dessert on the dish sheet. Up to three guests, and kids can decorate cookies at the back table.

events.title: Annual meeting
events.description: Residents only, no guests. On the agenda: the board report, next year's budget, and votes on the courtyard beds and bike room tags. Childcare in the side room if you mention it in your RSVP.

events.title: February book night
events.description: Two new members join us tonight, so we start with quick introductions. Bring the book and any pages you flagged. One guest each, and boots off at the door please.

events.title: Indoor futsal fun day
events.description: Small-sided games in the gym to keep the kids moving over winter. Indoor shoes only, no cleats on the gym floor. One guest per family, and the bleachers are open for parents.

events.title: Winter potluck
events.description: This year the dish sheet is on the event page, so we do not end up with six pasta salads. Setup starts at 4:30 if you can lend a hand. Three guests per household, and please take your dishes home after.

events.title: Spring season kickoff
events.description: Games start the following Saturday, so this is the last chance to swap uniform sizes. If you have not paid spring fees yet, bring cash or a check for the assistant coach. Light rain does not cancel.

events.title: Seed starting night
events.description: Starting tomatoes, peppers and herbs in trays for the new courtyard beds. Soil and seeds are provided; bring egg cartons or yogurt cups if you have them. Twenty spots, one guest each, kids over six welcome to help.

events.title: April book night
events.description: We wrap up the winter pick and decide how to split the May book across two nights. Come up at 7, buzzer 4C. One guest each, and guests should tell the host who they are coming with.

events.title: Spring garden build day
events.description: Raised beds, soil and seedlings for the courtyard. Gloves provided; carpools leave from the Building A lot.

events.title: End-of-season team picnic
events.description: Families welcome. Siblings count as children; babies under two do not need a place.

events.title: May book night: The Overstory
events.description: We discuss the first half. Tea and cake at Pippa's.

events.title: Bike room cleanout
events.description: Tag your bike by April 24; untagged bikes go to the donation rack.

events.title: Spring social planning meeting
events.description: Planning the June courtyard social. Hosts and volunteers.

events.title: Coaches and helpers meeting
events.description: Picnic logistics and next season. Coaches and helpers.

events.title: June book night: The Overstory, part two
events.description: We finish the book. Courtyard if dry.
